draft.title: Why might Qwen3-8B Q6_K_L run slowly on a TitanXP with LM Studio?
draft.body:

Given this hardware, which is somewhat dated but still capable, it raises questions about how well LM Studio handles this quantized model variant. 

Is the slowdown primarily due to LM Studio’s compatibility or optimization with Q6_K_L quantization, or could it be related to GPU memory management on a TitanXP? Has anyone else experienced similar performance quirks with Qwen3-8B Q6_K_L on comparable setups? Understanding this might help clarify whether the bottleneck is software-related or hardware-limited in practice.

Any insights on tuning LM Studio or alternative approaches to improve responsiveness with this model on older GPUs would be appreciated.
